description: Current Freematics link, transport, packet age, fresh ECU values and vehicle telemetry. Historical trip selection belongs in the Trips view.

links.title: Live vehicle view
links.tooltip: Open current link and fresh telemetry

links.title: Historical trips view
links.tooltip: Open the trip index and route evidence

panels.description: Online means the collector has received telemetry within its channel timeout.
panels.title: Vehicle link

panels.description: Transport reported by the firmware: cellular is preferred; Wi-Fi is fallback.
panels.title: Active uplink

panels.description: Age of the newest packet at the collector. Live telemetry cards and charts hide values after 15 seconds; parked standby deliberately creates longer gaps.
panels.title: Telemetry age

panels.description: Voltage reported by the Freematics power input. Bench USB voltage is not a vehicle-battery reading.
panels.title: Vehicle voltage

panels.description: Live ECU fuel-tank percentage, only while its reported age is at most 15 seconds. This is a gauge percentage, not litres; red means at or below 15%.
panels.title: Fuel level

panels.description: Satellites used by the current fix. No value indoors is expected, not fabricated as zero.
panels.title: GPS satellites

panels.description: Total stored, pending and permanent DTCs from the latest completed scan.
panels.title: Diagnostic faults

panels.description: Oldest currently cached ECU PID value. Values older than 15 seconds are hidden from live charts and summaries. The raw inventory still reports their age.
panels.title: ECU data age

panels.description: Optional standard Mode 01 PID A6, converted from kilometres to miles. Many ECUs do not advertise it; no manufacturer-specific odometer value is inferred.
panels.title: Odometer

panels.description: UK display units: OBD and GPS speed are shown in mph; RPM uses the right axis. Gaps remain visible instead of being invented.
panels.title: Road speed and engine speed

panels.description: Bias-corrected MEMS acceleration. Mount the unit consistently before interpreting X as acceleration/braking.
panels.title: Acceleration by device axis

panels.description: Only PIDs advertised by the ECU appear. Missing accelerator or torque series means unsupported, not zero.
panels.title: Engine load and driver demand

panels.description: Coolant, intake, oil, catalyst and ambient temperatures, plus the logger enclosure, when exposed.
panels.title: Thermal system

panels.description: Fuel gauge percentage and closed-loop trims stay on the primary axis. Equivalence ratio uses the right axis; fuel percentage is not a volume measurement.
panels.title: Fuel level, trim and mixture

panels.description: Intake, fuel-rail, barometric and evaporative pressures with mass airflow on its own axis.
panels.title: Airflow and pressure

panels.description: Satellite count and HDOP explain route quality; altitude uses the right axis.
panels.title: GPS quality

panels.description: Connection, active trip and transport transitions over the selected range. Parked standby deliberately creates an offline interval.
panels.title: Operating state

panels.description: Signal strength, decoded sample throughput and packet age expose connectivity degradation without oversized status cards.
panels.title: Radio and telemetry health

panels.description: Fuel rate is shown directly when standard PID 0x5E is reported. The MAF estimate is a transparent petrol-only fallback (14.7:1 AFR, 745 g/L) and is not calibrated consumption; fuel percentage alone cannot produce efficiency.

panels.title: Fuel rate and economy

panels.description: Application payload accepted by the collector during the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: Telemetry payload in range

panels.description: Payload estimate at £0.005 per decimal MB. It assumes all collector payload used cellular and excludes TCP, TLS and mobile-network overhead.
panels.title: Estimated SIM payload cost

panels.description: Average accepted payload rate across the selected dashboard range, including parked time.
panels.title: Average payload rate

panels.description: Thirty-day projection from the average payload rate in the selected range. Actual Simbase billing includes network overhead and excludes Wi-Fi traffic.
panels.title: 30-day payload estimate

panels.description: Every standard Mode 01 PID the vehicle advertised, with friendly metadata from kierandrewett/obd. 'Latest fresh' is blank when an ECU value is older than 15 seconds. A missing row means the ECU did not advertise that PID; it is never shown as zero.
panels.title: Every ECU metric exposed by this vehicle

panels.description: Ignition timing, oxygen-sensor voltage and commanded air-fuel equivalence. These values help to investigate combustion behaviour; they are not a direct emissions test.
panels.title: Combustion and exhaust

panels.description: Useful ECU lifetime and service counters, including odometer when the ECU advertises optional Mode 01 PID A6. They are direct ECU reports, not values calculated from the short current trip.
panels.title: ECU service and emissions counters

panels.description: OBD state, bridge protocol, advertised PID count, timeout count, response latency and core-cycle failures. A disconnected or degraded state explains missing ECU values.
panels.title: OBD quality

panels.description: Filled telemetry readings and encoded bytes waiting for upload. A growing queue indicates transport back-pressure; a stale device age hides the series.
panels.title: Telemetry queue

panels.description: Latest fresh diagnostic scan result: no response, a response with no codes, or one or more codes. The age gate prevents an old scan from being presented as current.
panels.title: Diagnostic scan
